description: This source file defines extension functions for the Kotlin Flow type to facilitate collection of flow emissions synchronized with Android lifecycle states or a provided CoroutineScope.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Collects from the Flow within a LifecycleOwner, respecting its lifecycle state, and executes a suspending action for each emitted value.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Collects from the Flow within a given CoroutineScope and executes a suspending action for each emitted value.
